name: Differential Operator Self-Adjointness
description: Replaces the matrix multiplication and vector fixed-point condition with the composition of linear differential operators and a formal self-adjointness condition (integral equality). This perfectly preserves the XOR logic (1 and 2 commute to a self-adjoint operator, while 1-1 and 2-2 do not) while moving the domain from linear algebra to functional analysis. It defeats models that write simple Python scripts to test transformations, because evaluating definite integrals of abstract functions over the real line is extremely difficult for LLM-generated sympy scripts.
